# Hike RV

> Hike RV is an Australian manufacturer of off-road caravans — family, couples and luxury models — designed and built at our factory in Campbellfield, Victoria.

## Business details
- Website: https://www.hikervcaravans.com.au
- Factory / showroom: 43-45 Salvator Dr, Campbellfield VIC 3061, Australia
- Phone: +61 402 940 008
- Contact: https://www.hikervcaravans.com.au/contact
- Dealers: https://www.hikervcaravans.com.au/dealers

## Models
- [Rover Series](https://www.hikervcaravans.com.au/rover): family off-road caravans with bunk layouts and safety-first design.
- [Drifter Series](https://www.hikervcaravans.com.au/drifter): agile, modern off-road caravans for couples and small families.
- [Elite Series](https://www.hikervcaravans.com.au/elite): flagship luxury off-road caravans.
- [Huttle](https://www.hikervcaravans.com.au/huttle): compact, efficient caravan.
- [Toy Haulers](https://www.hikervcaravans.com.au/toy-haulers): coming soon.

## Factory specifications
- 100% Australian-built in Victoria using premium local steel.
- CNC-cut, interlocking chassis frames, handcrafted by a specialised team.
- Independent trailing-arm off-road suspension with dual shock absorbers.
- Off-grid energy: high-capacity solar arrays and lithium battery management.
- 2-year manufacturer's structural warranty.
